bio: This former village café has lost none of its yesteryear appeal, even though the draught beer taps and bar stools have given way to a warm modern interior, whose open-plan kitchen cannot fail but catch the eye. Steven crafts tasty dishes oozing with flavour, including a patriotic line-up of Belgian classics such as his own take on pear Belle Hélène. His partner Lies elegantly welcomes guests to the establishment....
